entities.summary:
The Historic Villages of Portugal are a group of 12 villages classified under a 1991 government program called the Historic Villages Program. The aim of the program was to restore and promote a series of ancient villages/human settlements important to the history of Portugal. Starting in 1991 the government included 10 villages located in the Beira Interior in the Historic Villages program:Almeida
Castelo Mendo
Castelo Novo
Castelo Rodrigo
Idanha-a-Velha
Linhares da Beira
Marialva
Monsanto
Piódão
Sortelha
